# Archived UI-pass agent brief

This is a non-executable tombstone for the one-off `fortheemperor` UI-pass instructions that previously occupied this active agent-discovery path.

Do not use this file to switch or create branches, edit files, run tests/builds, commit, open a PR, publish, or infer any current UI objective. The historical brief remains recoverable from Git history; keeping its imperative text in `.github/agents/` made it unsafe as standing automation guidance.

For a current UI task, begin at root `AGENTS.md`, follow explicit owner scope and approval gates, read `SOT.md` plus the current `CHANGELOG.md`, verify the current branch/worktree, and inspect current UI contracts/code. Any meaningful change requires the governed synchronized change bundle.
